reason: The raw association (1.78) vanishes once pre-treatment confounders (size, tenure, prior growth) are controlled. The null of about 0.05 (CI roughly -0.4 to 0.5) holds with all pre-period covariates, a quadratic term, and subgroup interactions. The analyst rightly left out post-treatment buyer_rating_2023, which flips the sign if added, so the 'no effect' conclusion is supported.
